eps.ov: Pop princess Sakura is drawn into the brutal world of women's professional wrestling after sadistic lady brawler by the name of Rio humiliates one of her fellow idols!
After some grueling training and an agonizing initiation ritual, Sakura makes her pro wrestling debut!
Sakura's heartbreaking losing streak reaches double digits, and her fans begin to lose faith. The idol considers quitting, but a sparring session with Misaki may change her mind!
Thanks to some special training from Misaki, the beautiful and determined Sakura is ready for her next match! Will her hard work finally pay off?

eps.t: The Night Before the Decisive Fight
eps.ov: Sakura continues to push her body to the breaking point under the watchful eye of Misaki - but what she really needs is a signature move worthy of an idol!
Sakura finally turns her idol training into a formidable signature move. Basking in the glow of her first victory, the brawling beauty vows to work even harder!

eps.t: The World Champion Comes to Japan
eps.ov: The return of world champ Jackall Tojo - and an unexpected injury to Misaki - lands Sakura a coveted spot in a very special wrestling match!

eps.t: The Power of the World Champ
eps.ov: Despite her growing strength, improved technique, and signature move, Sakura is defeated by a true champion. Undaunted, the idol-turned-wrestler is eager for another shot at the top!
A fighter with a background in karate officially joins the ranks, and Sakura is challenged by a mysterious masked wrestler!
Sakura must dig deep to overcome her opponent's karate skills, and the masked wrestler's shocking identity is finally revealed!
Sakura and her old friend Elena pummel each other provocatively in sweaty, sexy grudge match for the ages!
The spirited, and sadistic, match between Sakura and Elena reaches its epic, pulse-pounding climax!
